end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Identified flat and curved faces using cylinders and spheres.
Answered 4 of 8 naming attempts without help and 2 of 2 face-property attempts without help.
Initially treated an upside-down cone as a different shape; corrected this by turn 9.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming solid shapes in toys and objects, then checked whether they have flat faces, curved faces, or both. Using familiar examples such as a pencil and ball supported the explanations. The mix-up about a cone changing name when turned was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to find one cone, cylinder, sphere, cube, or cuboid and describe its faces, including when it is turned around.
